Singlets plots:
```{r}
singlets = annot %>% filter(spot_class == "singlet")
type_counts = singlets %>% count(first_type, sort = TRUE)

bg <- annot %>% select(x, y)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = bg, aes(x = y, y = -x),
             colour = "grey90", size = 0.05, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = singlets, aes(x = y, y = -x, colour = first_type),
             size = 0.1, shape = 16) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cell_colours, drop = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ first_type, ncol = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggtitle("RCTD Singlet Cell-Type Annotations — V2 (8 µm bins)")
```
Plotting by cell_type class:
```{r}
class_pct <- annot %>%
  count(spot_class) %>%
  mutate(pct   = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
         label = paste0(spot_class, " (", pct, "%)"))

annot2 <- annot %>%
  left_join(class_pct %>% select(spot_class, label), by = "spot_class")

level_order <- c("singlet", "doublet_certain", "doublet_uncertain", "reject")
extra <- setdiff(unique(annot2$spot_class), level_order)
level_order <- c(level_order, extra)

annot2$spot_class <- factor(annot2$spot_class, levels = level_order)
annot2$label      <- factor(annot2$label,
                         levels = class_pct$label[match(level_order, class_pct$spot_class)])

ggplot(annot2, aes(x = y, y = -x)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#3182BD", size = 0.02, shape = 16, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggtitle("RCTD Classification Categories — V2 (8 µm bins)")
```

# Sanity Check Plots:
```{r}
shared = intersect(singlets$barcode, colnames(counts))
singlets = singlets[match(shared, singlets$barcode), ]
counts_s = counts[, shared, drop = FALSE]
labels = setNames(singlets$first_type, singlets$barcode)

# Pseudobulk: Sum Raw counts per cell type:
cell_types = sort(unique(labels))
gt_ref_raw <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  bc_ct <- names(labels)[labels == ct]
  Matrix::rowSums(counts_s[, bc_ct, drop = FALSE])   # G-vector, fast
})

# gt_ref_raw is now G × K — small dense matrix
rownames(gt_ref_raw) <- rownames(counts_s)
colnames(gt_ref_raw) <- cell_types

# ── Normalise pseudobulk to CP10k, then log ──
ct_size_factors <- colSums(gt_ref_raw) / 1e4
gt_ref_norm     <- sweep(gt_ref_raw, 2, ct_size_factors, "/")
gt_ref_log      <- log1p(gt_ref_norm)

# ── Transpose to K × G for cor_matrix_plot_gt ──
gt_ref <- t(gt_ref_log)

cor_matrix_plot_gt(
  gt_ref     = gt_ref,
  title      = "Pearson correlation: RCTD first_type singlets (log-normalised pseudobulk)",
  type       = "pearson",
  axis_label = "RCTD cell types"
)
```


```{r}
gene_var = apply(gt_ref, 2, var)
gene_var = sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE)
cum_share <- cumsum(gene_var) / sum(gene_var)

cat("Top 10 genes:   ", round(cum_share[10],   3), "of variance\n")
cat("Top 50 genes:   ", round(cum_share[50],   3), "\n")
cat("Top 200 genes:  ", round(cum_share[200],  3), "\n")
cat("Top 1000 genes: ", round(cum_share[1000], 3), "\n")

cor_mat <- cor(t(gt_ref), method = "pearson")
round(cor_mat, 2)
```
